sentence: Lightning is flashing somewhere right now, about forty-four times every second, all around the planet.
claim: Global flash rate about 44 flashes a second (Christian et al. 2003, from NASA's Optical Transient Detector).
source_title: Christian et al., 'Global frequency and distribution of lightning as observed from space by the Optical Transient Detector', J. Geophys. Res. 108 (2003)
note: OPEN: NOT read. NOT READ: doi.org was blocked and PubMed had no abstract. The figure is from memory (about 44 +/- 5 a second); a person must open the paper.

sentence: That adds up to more than a billion flashes in a year.
claim: 44 x 31.6 million s = 1.39 billion flashes a year (calc.py: flashes).
source_title: Derivation (calc.py) from the inputs of claims c1, c3 and c5; no outside page
note: DERIVATION: arithmetic on the rate (c1), the energy of a flash (c3) and world electricity (c5); not read from any page. OPEN until a person re-does the sum and opens the pages that give its inputs.

sentence: One flash carries roughly a billion joules, a rough guess with a wide range.
claim: Energy of one lightning flash is of order 1e9 J (a billion joules), with a wide range (about 1e8 to 1e10 J).
source_title: NWS/NOAA lightning science; Rakov & Uman, Lightning: Physics and Effects (2003)
note: OPEN: NOT read. NOT READ (weather.gov returned nothing to this container). Order-of-magnitude figure from memory; the coordinator asked for a range, so the film says 'roughly' and shows 0.5 to 47 days.

sentence: That is about four hundred billion kilowatt-hours, a very big number.
claim: 1.39e9 flashes x 1e9 J = 1.39e18 J = 386 billion kWh (1 kWh = 3.6e6 J).
source_title: Derivation (calc.py) from the inputs of claims c1, c3 and c5; no outside page

sentence: The world uses nearly eighty times more electricity in a year.
claim: World electricity generation is about 30,000 TWh a year (about 2023); 30,000 / 386 = 78.
source_title: Ember, Global Electricity Review / Electricity Data Explorer (or IEA)

sentence: All the lightning on Earth would run it for about five days.
